note: Seeded fault models (protocol section 5). Injection seed = 20260917 + injection index; each injection targets one distinct chunk chosen by seeded uniform draw over eligible chunks of the (item, profile) plan; faults are applied to a copy so the no-fault archive is also produced and must equal production bytes. Expected detection per scope is FORMALLY_DERIVED in protocol H1a and checked by check_detection.py.

models.stage: encoder output (stored payload) after encode, before framing

variants.note: payload of another chunk with the same plan and stored length within +-5%, padded or trimmed to exact length

models.eligible: chunks whose selected plan has a structural step
